items.quote: assessed at both the full-text screening and final inclusion stages using sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, AUC, and calibration metrics.

key_findings: Performance varied widely across models, with high sensitivity but many false positives in the smaller review and high specificity but low recall in the larger review.
Calibration was weak for single‑model configurations despite high overall accuracy.
The actor‑critic framework improved discrimination (higher AUC) and markedly reduced calibration error in both reviews.
limitations_reported: Evaluation was conducted on only two systematic reviews, limiting generalizability; performance varied across reviews suggesting sensitivity to criteria and abstract characteristics; not all LLMs or prompting strategies were exhaustively tested; human feedback was not formally evaluated.
